# Fixora Studio

> Fixora Studio is a software development studio serving businesses worldwide, with website content in English and Indonesian.

Services include custom SaaS and web applications, mobile apps for iOS and Android, AI workflow automation, internal dashboards, and marketing websites. Project scope and delivery timelines are agreed directly with the team.

Contact: hitmeup@fixorastudio.com. Canonical website: https://fixorastudio.com.

Based in Tegal, Central Java, Indonesia. Address: Jalan Raya 2, Ujungrusi, Adiwerna, Kab. Tegal, Jawa Tengah, Indonesia, 52194.

## Service overview

- Mobile apps: Native-feeling iOS and Android products with polished user flows and production-ready foundations.
- Internal dashboards: Operations, reporting, and administration tools for everyday team workflows.
- AI automation: Tool integrations, triggered actions, data summaries, and automated business handoffs.
- Web design and development: Landing pages, product websites, and marketing experiences focused on design and performance.
- SaaS development: MVPs and product foundations, including authentication, SaaS workflows, and billing-ready interfaces.

## Project inquiries

Send a project brief, questions, or build request to [hitmeup@fixorastudio.com](mailto:hitmeup@fixorastudio.com). Describe your goal and requirements so the team can discuss scope and delivery.

The website describes a two-week sprint offering. Suitability, pricing, scope, and delivery commitments must be confirmed with the team for each project; this is not a universal delivery guarantee.
